description: This file defines the RouteContext class within the Slim Framework, handling the retrieval and management of routing context data from an HTTP request, including route, parser, routing results, and base path.

classes.name: RouteContext
classes.description: A final class representing routing context information extracted from an HTTP request in the Slim Framework.

methods.name: fromRequest
methods.description: Creates a RouteContext instance from a ServerRequest object, extracting route-related attributes.

parameters.name: serverRequest
parameters.description: The incoming server request from which to extract routing attributes.

methods.name: getRoute
methods.description: Returns the associated route, if any.

methods.name: getRouteParser
methods.description: Returns the route parser used in the routing process.

methods.name: getRoutingResults
methods.description: Returns the routing results associated with the request.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the base path; throws an exception if not defined.
